correctness.rationale: The edge-deletion monitoring predicate is equivalent to no selected cyclic gap of length at least n/2, including a strict exclusion of antipodal geodesic ties. Count each long gap by initial vertex and possible remainder with a hockey-stick sum; distinct long gaps cannot coexist except the two antipodal gaps of one even two-set. This gives (1+z)^n-1-nz(1+z)^floor(n/2)+1_even*(n/2)z². Deleting a vertex merges adjacent gaps; summing all merged-gap inequalities bounds minimal sizes by three (odd) or four (even), with even 4-sets exactly unions of two antipodal pairs. Completing the unique long gap gives precisely n maximal bad contiguous blocks of size floor(n/2)+1. Independently reconstructed shortest paths before/after each deleted edge and counted every subset for C3..C10 with matching outputs. The proof, not finite n checks, covers all n>=3.
residual_risks: Unweighted simple cycles only. No extrapolation from finite checks.

value.rationale: The all-cardinality MEG placement spectrum is a natural reliability invariant for probe selection and quantifies both sharp guaranteed coverage and all boundary minimally sufficient placements. Counting all sets and maximal failures is materially beyond the known scalar monitoring number; this is an infinite-family combinatorial classification, not merely code or rebranding.
